svg.title: Benchmark
svg.desc: Metric: Cold start to first page, Umbra: umbra stop, wait for the daemon to exit, then time umbra open /login, Playwright: launch + newContext + newPage + goto; Metric: One-shot read, cold, Umbra: umbra stop, then time umbra read /login < /dev/null (no daemon: it starts WebKit in its own process), Playwright: none; Metric: Warm navigate, Umbra: open /app, Playwright: goto('/app'); Metric: Accessibility snapshot, Umbra: snapshot on /app/orders, Playwright: locator('body').ariaSnapshot(); Metric: Click + DOM update, Umbra: click <ref> on the switch (its aria-checked flips), Playwright: locator('#notifications').click(); Metric: Fill, Umbra: fill <ref> <value> on the controlled input, Playwright: locator('#display-name').fill(); Metric: Viewport screenshot, Umbra: screenshot <file>, Playwright: screenshot({path}) at the same device pixel ratio; Metric: Eval round trip, Umbra: eval "return 1 + 1", Playwright: evaluate('1 + 1')
